name: GLab
description: GLab is where Guang shares practical projects, technical guides, and lessons from networking, cybersecurity, AI, hands-on engineering, community technology, and sustainable farming.

intro: I enjoy figuring out how systems work and building tools that make a real task easier. My interests stretch from networking and cybersecurity to AI, hands-on engineering, community projects, and sustainable farming.

I’m passionate about building a future where technology and nature coexist harmoniously. I enjoy exploring cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, sustainable farming, networking, and hands-on engineering projects. I believe in using technology thoughtfully to create positive change for people, communities, and the planet.

GLab is where I collect the projects, guides, and notes I want to explain properly—what a project is for, how it developed, what I learned, and what still needs work. I’m learning as I build, so I distinguish finished work from experiments and retired systems.
profile.statement: Build things that help with real work. Write down what I learn. Think about the people and places affected by the tools.
profile.workLine: Projects with context, not just a demo.
profile.interestLine: Practical questions about systems, people, and the living world.
profile.background: GLab grew from practical broadband and network-operations work. It now holds project case studies, smaller tools, guides, community technology, and questions about using technology thoughtfully alongside nature.
